question: How many runs did India’s women’s team score to set a national record in a One-Day International against Ireland in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**435**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **India Women’s cricket team** created history on **January 17, 2025**, by scoring a massive total of **435/4** in a **One-Day International (ODI)** against **Ireland**.
 
• This score of **435 runs** set a new **national record** for the **highest team total** by the **Indian Women's team** in the history of **ODI cricket**.
 
• The match was the **first ODI** of the three-match series, held at the **Niranjan Shah Stadium** in **Rajkot**, Gujarat.
 
• The innings featured a historic **double century** by star opener **Smriti Mandhana**, who scored **209 runs** off just **145 balls**, becoming the **first Indian woman** to reach the **200-run mark** in **ODIs**.
 
• Captain **Harmanpreet Kaur** also played a blistering knock, contributing **117 runs** off **61 deliveries**, which helped the team surpass the **400-run mark** for the first time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Previous Record:** Before this match, **India’s** highest total in **Women's ODIs** was **358/2**, which was also achieved against **Ireland** in **May 2017** during a quadrangular series in **South Africa**.
 
• **Smriti Mandhana’s Achievement:** With her **209-run** innings, **Smriti Mandhana** registered the **third-highest individual score** in **Women's ODI** history, trailing only **Amelia Kerr** (**232***) and **Belinda Clark** (**229***).
 
• **Partnership Record:** During this innings, **Mandhana** and **Kaur** shared a record-breaking **239-run partnership** for the **third wicket**, which is one of the highest in the history of the format.
 
• **Global Context:** While **435** is **India's national record**, the overall world record for the highest team total in **Women's ODIs** is held by **New Zealand**, who scored **491/4** against **Ireland** in **2018**.
 
• **Series Significance:** This match was part of the **ICC Women's Championship** cycle, which is crucial for **direct qualification** for the **2025 Women's Cricket World Cup**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Venue:** The **Niranjan Shah Stadium** (formerly known as the **Saurashtra Cricket Association Stadium**) in **Rajkot** provided a high-scoring pitch that facilitated several records during the **January 2025** series.
 
• **Match Result:** India won the match by a massive margin of **328 runs** after bowling out **Ireland** for **107**, marking one of their **largest victories** in terms of runs.
 
• **Statistical Milestone:** This was only the **fourth time** in **Women's ODI** history that a team managed to cross the **400-run** threshold, joining the ranks of **New Zealand** and **Australia**.
 
• **Smriti Mandhana** hit **26 boundaries** and **6 sixes** during her record-breaking knock, demonstrating a strike rate of over **144**.
